name: VVVVK: Rogue Vampire Hunter
source: When you find yourself caught in the ancient war between humans and vampires, you only have one option—fight! But the enemy of humanity is overpowered, and you don't stand a chance of facing them head-on. It’s time to infiltrate the ranks of the strongest vampires alive and hope you have what it takes to survive.
translation: 当你发现自己陷入了人类与吸血鬼之间的古老战争时，你只有一个选择——战斗！但人类的敌人已经被压倒，你没有机会正面面对他们。是时候渗透到现存最强大的吸血鬼行列中，并希望你拥有生存所需的一切。
